# Berlin Umweltgerechtigkeit WFS fixtures

These offline fixtures contain three unmodified features, including their original geometries, cut from the eight provider GeoJSON layer downloads in `~/ug-work/` on 18 October 2026. The selected Planungsräume are `01100101`, `03400831`, and `06200418`; the latter two preserve source null and `-` cases. Fixture metadata sets `numberMatched` to three and removes paging links for bounded offline tests.

Source: Umweltatlas Berlin, Senatsverwaltung für Mobilität, Verkehr, Klimaschutz und Umwelt Berlin, WFS `ua_umweltgerechtigkeit2023`, package `umweltgerechtigkeit-2023-2024-umweltatlas-wfs-2d02ba21`.
